name: Seikatsu! ~Minna Daisuki! Kiwamete, Ero Lab!~
original_name: セイカツ！ ～みんな大好き！ 極めて、えろラボ！～
source: The protagonist is a transfer student and 2 weeks into school is approached by girl name Momoka. Being very shy around girls he runs away but for some reason Momoka keeps popping up. Shortly after the protagonist has trouble with random erection in school and goes to masturbate in restroom. He is caught by Momoka who takes photos on phone and black mails him, telling him to join the life research club so it doesn't fold. To his surprise life research club is about sex and researching it/practicing it. But the only person who seems interested is the president Momoka, sadly for rest of members Momoka doesn't take no for answer.
translation: 主角是转学生，入学两周后被名叫桃香的女孩搭话。他在女孩面前非常害羞，于是逃跑了，但不知为何桃香总是出现在他面前。不久后，主角在学校里莫名勃起，只好去厕所自慰。他被桃香抓个正着，桃香用手机拍下照片，以此勒索他，要求他加入生活研究社，否则社团就会被废部。令他惊讶的是，生活研究社研究的竟然是性爱，并且要亲身实践。不过，真正感兴趣的似乎只有社长桃香；对其他成员来说，桃香根本不接受拒绝。
